name: exchange-agentic-admin
description: Exchange Agentic Admin — AI Powered Exchange Operations Intelligence Platform (MCP server + Desktop for on-premise Exchange: EWS, REST, PowerShell)

scripts.build: tsc && node -e "import('node:fs').then(fs=>fs.cpSync('src/desktop/renderer','dist/desktop/renderer',{recursive:true}))" && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); let c=fs.readFileSync('dist/desktop/preload.js','utf8'); fs.writeFileSync('dist/desktop/preload.js', c.replace(/^export \{\};?$/m,''))"
scripts.desktop:dev: concurrently -k "tsc -w" "wait-on dist/desktop/main.js && node -e \"const fs=require('fs'); let c=fs.readFileSync('dist/desktop/preload.js','utf8'); fs.writeFileSync('dist/desktop/preload.js', c.replace(/^export \{\};?$/m,''))\" && electron dist/desktop/main.js --enable-logging"
